## Problem

What was wrong or missing, in the terms a user of the board would describe it. If you are
fixing an issue, link it here.

## Change

What you changed and why this is the smallest change that fixes it. If you considered another
approach and rejected it, say so in a sentence.

## Verification

What you did to convince yourself the change works, and what you observed. Name the commands
you ran and the values you saw in the browser. Screenshots are welcome but do not replace the
sentence.

- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] Loaded the board in a browser and observed the corrected behaviour

## Not verified

What you did not check, and anything a reviewer should look at more carefully than the rest.

## Assumptions

Anything you had to decide for yourself because the issue did not say.
